purpose: Part C: for each of the nine current TMI hub routes, specifies current vs. absent vs. future-only modules, required content objects and proof-registry references, review requirements, test cases, a four-state definition of done, explicit blockers, and explicit non-actions. Documentation and test-planning only -- no route was modified in this pass beyond what this document itself describes as already true.
companionDocuments: docs/mark-5-tmi-content-model-and-proof-registry.md / .json (Parts A, B, E -- the content objects and proof IDs referenced below)

definitionOfDoneStates.Building: Current, already-shipped state: restrained category-level description, honest posture badge, zero conversion surface. This is the state every route below is already in.
definitionOfDoneStates.Evidence-ready: All required content objects and proof-registry entries for the route have reached 'evidence supplied' / 'internally evidenced' or better, but no conversion mechanism has been added and no route-level review has been signed off.
definitionOfDoneStates.Conversion-ready: Evidence-ready, plus the route's required legal/privacy/editorial/operational/accessibility reviews are all signed off, plus a specific conversion mechanism (form/intake/link) has been designed but not yet activated -- this is the 'future inert prototype' state, still not live.
definitionOfDoneStates.Release-candidate: Conversion-ready, plus explicit owner authorization to activate the conversion mechanism -- the only state at which a route may leave 'Building' for a real offer. No route in this document is at this state.
